source_revision: original, no known revisions
claim_text_paraphrased: Hugging Face states the intrusion began by abusing two separate code-execution weaknesses in its dataset-processing pipeline to run code on a processing worker, after which the actor escalated to node-level access, harvested cloud and cluster credentials, and moved laterally into several internal clusters over the course of a weekend.

source_revision: original, no known revisions
claim_text_paraphrased: Hugging Face states the campaign was run by an autonomous agent framework that appeared to be built on an agentic security-research harness, but that it could not determine which underlying language model powered the attacking agents.

source_revision: original, no known revisions

source_revision: original, no known revisions

source_revision: original, no known revisions
